# Attribution

## External Assets

**None.** All visual and audio assets in Token Runner are procedurally generated by the project itself:

- Sprites and tiles: `scripts/tools/asset_generator_runtime.gd`
- Audio: `scripts/autoload/audio_manager.gd` (synthesized tones and noise)

No third-party art, music, fonts, or libraries are bundled with this project.
